PO/WO requires maximum details of billing address, delivery address with contact details; GST Certificate is mandatory.

Risk after loading on vehicle and onward transit are in account & scope of buyer only. During transit & unloading at delivery place, if any damages occur, they will be repaired by supplier at additional cost as per actual including material and to & fro fare for service engineer staff/team and its manpower.
Supplier is allowed to generate part load invoices and challans during dispatches if required.

general_terms: All materials or products are subject to pre-inspection at our works as per quotation specifications by client.
All documents like challan/bills, inspection sheet to be signed and stamped by buyer during goods receipt, and MRN/GRN to be prepared the same day by buyer's store in-charge.

In case of on-site installation, saved materials are taken back and their ownership remains with supplier only.

Any debit, refund or other charge denied or delayed due to non-compliance by the buyer (including failure to upload or incorrect disclosure on the GSTIN portal, or delay/failure to deposit tax within due dates) shall not be imposed on the supplier.
Supplier has the right to stop supply and installation if buyer fails to provide site facilities, power, safety, PPE if applicable.
